name: adlane
description: Ad library search MCP connector by Adlane: see competitor ads on Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Google at once, save ad creative to boards and track competitors.
long_description: Ad library search for competitor ads: search the Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Google ad libraries in one call. An ad spy for ad creative research and ad intelligence. search_ads finds live and recent ads by keyword, advertiser or website domain with copy, creative, start dates, placements and landing pages; each call uses one search from your Adlane plan. get_usage shows searches left. list_boards, get_board, create_board and save_ad manage saved-ad boards. list_competitors and track_competitor follow competitors and flag their new ads. Sign in with your Adlane account in the browser; Free accounts include 5 free searches to try it, no card.
